Placemaker.Recipe.AbandonedLot.Descripti: A forgotten plot: broken foundations, rubble, weeds reclaiming the ground, a rotting fence.
Placemaker.Abandoned.Name: Abandoned lot
Placemaker.Abandoned.subtype.Tooltip: What happened here. Each type lays the lot out differently.
Placemaker.Abandoned.overgrowth.Tooltip: How far wild plants have taken back the lot. They come from the edges and up through the cracks.
Placemaker.Abandoned.rubble.Tooltip: Rubble around the collapse point: big piles near it, smaller chunks and dust further out.
Placemaker.Abandoned.junk.Tooltip: Dumped tyres, barrels, pallets and carts, mostly near the street and the fence.
Placemaker.Abandoned.graffiti.Tooltip: Graffiti decals on wall remnants and along the fence.
Placemaker.Abandoned.foundations.Tooltip: Old concrete slabs of buildings that stood here.
Placemaker.Abandoned.cracking.Tooltip: How badly the slabs are broken: more cracks, wider gaps, missing pieces.
Placemaker.Abandoned.groundPaint.Tooltip: Paints bare dirt on the terrain (permanent, stays after removal).
Placemaker.Abandoned.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
Placemaker.Abandoned.desirePaths.Tooltip: Worn dirt tracks where people cut across between the gaps in the fence.
Placemaker.Abandoned.focus.Tooltip: Where the building came down: rubble is heaviest there.
Placemaker.Abandoned.mounds.Tooltip: Raises the ground into rubble mounds around the collapse point (permanent terraform, blended to the edge).
Placemaker.Abandoned.walls.Tooltip: Stretches of wall still standing on the edges of the foundations.
Placemaker.Abandoned.youngTrees.Tooltip: Self-seeded saplings, mostly in the corners and along the fence.
Placemaker.Abandoned.crackWeeds.Tooltip: Weeds growing up through the cracks of the slabs.
Placemaker.Abandoned.fenceGaps.Tooltip: Share of fence panels that have fallen or been torn out (in stretches).
Placemaker.Abandoned.shelters.Tooltip: Shacks and tarps around a fire in the most sheltered corner (at least four on a squatter camp).
Placemaker.Abandoned.Issue.NoCampSpot: No sheltered spot was big enough for the camp.
Placemaker.AddOn.Debris.Name: Debris & junk
Placemaker.AddOn.Debris.mix.Tooltip: Junk (tyres, barrels, pallets), rubble, or both.
Placemaker.AddOn.Debris.where.Tooltip: Dumped along the edges (over the fence) or scattered in the open.
